title: Break Your Fast With This
hook: I fast until about 2 PM every day, and this is what I break my fast with.
body: A low carb first meal like this salad is the habit I lean on most. If you break a fast with a pile of carbs, sugar or alcohol, the fast does a lot less for you.
close: Save this for your next fasting day.
